business_summary: Alibaba Health Information Technology Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the pharmaceutical direct sales, pharmaceutical e-commerce platform, and healthcare and digital services businesses in the People's Republic of China. It offers a range of prescription and over-the-counter drugs, nutritional supplements, medical devices, contact lenses, healthcare food, adult and family planning products, and various other health-related products. The company also provides medical and healthcare services, including medical checkups, testing, medical consultation, appointment-booking, physical examination, consultation, registration, vaccine, dentistry, psychology, optometry, and nursing services, as well as traditional chinese medicines. In addition, it engages in the digital tracking business; asset management; and operation of internet hospitals, as well as provision of network hospital, research, and Internet information services. Further, the company operates Alibaba Health, flagship platform of Alibaba Group for integrated online and offline medical and healthcare resources, providing one-stop healthcare solutions. It provides products and services to business-to-customer and business-to-business customers through offline pharmacy outlets, as well as online stores, such as Tmall, Taobao, Alipay, Taobao Instant Commerce, AMap, DingTalk, Freshippo, and Quark. The company was formerly known as CITIC 21CN Company Limited and changed its name to Alibaba Health Information Technology Limited in September 2014. Alibaba Health Information Technology Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Alibaba Health Information Technology Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 의약품 직접 판매, 의약품 전자상거래 플랫폼, 의료 및 디지털 서비스 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 다양한 처방약과 비처방약, 영양 보충제, 의료 기기, 콘택트 렌즈, 건강 관리 식품, 성인 및 가족 계획 제품, 기타 다양한 건강 관련 제품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 건강 검진, 테스트, 의료 상담, 예약, 신체 검사, 상담, 등록, 백신, 치과, 심리학, 검안 및 간호 서비스를 포함한 의료 및 건강 관리 서비스와 한약을 제공합니다. 또한 디지털 추적 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 자산 관리; 인터넷 병원 운영, 네트워크 병원 제공, 연구, 인터넷 정보 서비스 제공 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 또한, 온·오프라인 통합 의료·헬스케어 자원을 제공하는 알리바바그룹의 대표 플랫폼인 알리바바헬스를 운영하며 원스톱 헬스케어 솔루션을 제공하고 있다. 기업과 고객에게 제품과 서비스를 제공합니다.
